[[File:Steve Sanders (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Steve Sanders, from the community card ''Stephen S''.]]
'''Steve Sanders''' (also '''Stephen Sanders'''; forum and GEMP handle '''leverandon''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/Player_List_for_2026_Retro_GEMPC_forum_t86781 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished '''#32''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: BHBM; Light: TIGIH).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

He has been tournament director of the [[Retro League]] from 2023 to the present, opening each season's league thread and event threads as Leverandon<ref name="t82168">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82168 2023 Retro GEMP League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012162359/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t82168.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="t84002">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84002 2024 SWCCG Online Retro League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012162609/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84002.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="t85234">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85234 2025 SWCCG Online Retro League (& Cumulative Standings)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012163701/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85234.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="t86346">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86346 2026 SWCCG Online Retro League (& Cumulative Standings)], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164534/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86346.html Internet Archive].</ref>; the 2026 thread names him as the league's organizer.<ref name="rl-2026">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86346 2026 SWCCG Online Retro League], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164534/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86346.html Internet Archive].</ref> Geoff Bowman directed 2025 Event 4 while he took a break.<ref name="t85240">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=85240 Event #4 - 2025 Retro GEMP League - Classic No-V Constructed], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012164154/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t85240.html Internet Archive].</ref> In 2022, when [[Jared Napolitano]] was tournament director, he sent the kick-off and pairings emails.<ref name="t80194">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=80194 Event #1 - 2022 Retro GEMP League - P-ANH Constructed], forum.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160423/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t80194.html Internet Archive].</ref>
